diamond hands is slang for holding an asset through sharp price drops instead of selling. diamond hands is used in the community to signal strong conviction. diamond hands is typically used approvingly rather than as a warning.

Cope is slang for accepting a loss or a bad position. Cope is often used ironically or self-deprecatingly. Cope describes holders who keep a losing position rather than sell it.

Floor is lava is a meme phrase warning that a market or asset is dangerous to touch. Floor is lava signals a high risk of losses to other users.
